observations: Photo 0: A wooden pallet on a concrete floor; visible stringers and deck boards; some wear/staining on wood.
Photo 1: Another view of the same wooden pallet; stamped/printed text on the deck reads 'GOLDNEST' (partially visible).
Photo 2: Stacked wooden pallets in a warehouse; multiple pallets visible with similar construction and wear.

claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show wooden pallets used for storage/transport.

risks.risk: Condition/strength is unknown (possible broken boards, loose nails, or weak stringers). Photos show wear but not structural integrity.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing each corner and underside, plus close-ups of any cracked boards and where nails/blocks are loose.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: usable but not guaranteed strong (treat as lower condition).

risks.risk: Quantity is unclear (seller says pallets, but photos show at least one pallet clearly and stacks in the background).
risks.proof: Ask: 'How many pallets exactly am I buying?' and request a photo counting them (e.g., pallets lined up or labeled).

risks.risk: Size/type standard is unclear (could be different dimensions or a non-standard pallet size).
risks.proof: Ask for measurements: length x width x height (or deck size) with a tape measure in the photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: smaller/less desirable size for buyers.

risks.risk: Treatment/contamination risk (wood pallets may be treated with chemicals or have stains/odors). Photos cannot confirm treatment status.
risks.proof: Ask for any markings (e.g., HT/IPPC stamp) and request a close-up of stamps on the wood.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: no proof of safe treatment.

proof_requests: How many pallets are included in this sale (exact quantity)?
Video/close-ups of underside and all corners showing no broken stringers/boards and no loose nails.
Tape-measure photo with pallet dimensions (L x W x H).
Close-up of any wood stamps/marks (e.g., HT/IPPC) and underside markings.
response.reason: The photos clearly show wooden storage pallets, but condition, exact quantity, and dimensions are not fully verifiable remotely; so I price at the worst case using the closest available comparables provided.
